Problem: The ACTIVITY background-location task (walk/hike/outdoor-cycle) was only imported by the activity screen
Evidence: so TaskManager.defineTask was not guaranteed registered when iOS relaunches the app in the background.
User Impact: _layout.tsx previously imported only '../src/lib/gpsTracking'; activityGpsTracking imported only by activity/start.tsx.
Recommended Fix: Background GPS points/route could be dropped for non-run outdoor activities on a cold background relaunch.
Estimated Effort: Added `import '../src/lib/activityGpsTracking';` at app root next to gpsTracking.
Status: Startup test asserting both STRIDE_BACKGROUND_LOCATION and STRIDE_ACTIVITY_BACKGROUND_LOCATION are defined after importing app root.
column15: Needs on-device confirmation of background relaunch behavior.

Problem: Voice cues could not play while backgrounded/locked (shouldPlayInBackground:false; no `audio` UIBackgroundMode).
Evidence: voiceCoach.ts set shouldPlayInBackground:false; app.json declared no UIBackgroundModes.
User Impact: Spoken cues went silent when the phone locked mid-run — the core scenario.
Recommended Fix: Set shouldPlayInBackground:true and added UIBackgroundModes ['audio','location'] to app.json infoPlist.
Suggested Test Coverage: Config test on the audio-mode object; on-device locked-screen cue playback.
Notes: Needs Device QA on a signed build; confirm App Review notes reflect audio guidance during workouts.

Problem: User-reported: when a cue plays it ducks the music but never restores it. The audio session was set to duckOthers once and never released, so music stayed lowered for the rest of the run.
Evidence: audioSessionReady latched true; no setActive(false)/mix-mode switch after speech; drain() returned early on empty queue without releasing.
User Impact: Music/podcast volume stayed permanently ducked after the first cue until the app was closed.
Recommended Fix: Added releaseAudioSession() (switches to mixWithOthers) invoked when the queue drains and on clearVoiceCoachQueue; ensureAudioSession re-ducks for the next cue.
Suggested Test Coverage: On-device: play music, trigger a cue, confirm music returns to full volume after the cue.
Notes: Reported directly by the user during Build 49 review.

Line(s): voiceCoachingEngine.ts evaluateDistanceSplitCue; activeRunStore.ts addLocationUpdate + split state; settings voiceDistanceUpdateInterval
Problem: User-reported: audio only announced heart-rate zone and hydration/fuel reminders — never distance segments (half mile / mile splits). No distance-split cue logic existed anywhere.
Evidence: grep found HR-zone (voiceCoachingEngine), hydration/fuel (runReminderScheduler) cues but no mile/km split generator.
User Impact: Runners got no configurable per-half-mile/mile or per-half-km/km split and metric feedback during a run.
Recommended Fix: Added pure evaluateDistanceSplitCue engine with configurable half/full distance updates, split pace, average pace, and elapsed moving time; wired it into activeRunStore.addLocationUpdate and added a persisted Settings control. Category 'pace' still gates delivery.
Suggested Test Coverage: Unit tests cover pre-boundary suppression, half-mile update, full-mile update, latest-segment split pace, metric half-km update, and no re-announce.
Notes: Outdoor GPS only for now; treadmill/indoor split cues are a follow-up (distance there does not route through addLocationUpdate).

Problem: Widget deploymentTarget is 18.0 while native/JS treat Live Activities as available from iOS 16.1, so iOS <18 devices may report available but show no Live Activity.
Evidence: Widget Swift has no explicit @available gates, but the Lock-Screen control buttons use LiveActivityIntent which requires iOS 17+, so the floor cannot drop to 16.2.
User Impact: iOS 16-17 users may not see Live Activities.
Recommended Fix: DEFERRED: lowering the target (to 17.0 at most, given LiveActivityIntent) is a native-build change that cannot be validated here without an EAS build. Decide target vs. gating JS on iOS 18 and validate with a build.
Suggested Test Coverage: Contract test aligning the JS availability gate with the shipped widget deployment target.
Notes: Not changed — avoids an unvalidated build-config change that could break the next EAS build. iOS 18 adoption is high in 2026.

Problem: writeWorkout wrote estimatedLoad*1.05 as the workout's energyBurned; estimatedLoad is a TSS-analog training load
User Impact: training.ts:202 documents estimatedLoad as a TSS-analog; healthKit.ts passed it as totals.energyBurned.
Recommended Fix: An inaccurate calorie value was written into Apple Health and consumed by other apps; requesting Active Energy write permission would also overstate what StrideOS writes after removing fabricated calories.
Estimated Effort: Removed energyBurned from the write entirely (no fabricated kcal) and removed Active Energy from HealthKit SHARE_TYPES so the Apple Health write prompt matches actual writes.
Status: Contract test asserts Active Energy is not requested as a write category and no estimatedLoad-derived energy is written.
column15: A real kcal model could be added later if desired.

Problem: writeWorkout computed distance with no finite/positive guard.
Evidence: Prior code: distance = (actual ?? estimated) * 1609.344 with no guard.
User Impact: Edge-case NaN/zero distance could reach Apple Health or the native bridge.
Suggested Test Coverage: Unit test with missing/NaN distance asserting no distance is written.

Problem: end fell back to sessionSource 'training_block' when the session store was already cleared
Evidence: which could fail to match an activity started under a different source.
User Impact: endStrengthLiveActivity defaulted sessionSource to 'training_block'; native matches() requires source match unless requested source is empty.
Recommended Fix: Rare stale strength Live Activity left on the Lock Screen.
Estimated Effort: Changed the fallback to '' (native treats empty as a wildcard).
Status: Test end-after-clear resolves to the most-recent/wildcard match.
column15: Native singleStrengthActivityFallback already mitigated most cases.

Problem: Two modules export formatDistance with incompatible signatures
Evidence: and lib/units used slightly off km constants (1.60934) vs the canonical 1.609344.
User Impact: grep of both importer sets; differing constants.
Recommended Fix: Latent footgun plus tiny cross-screen distance rounding drift.
Estimated Effort: Made lib/units use the canonical 1.609344 (reciprocal for the inverse) and added a cross-reference comment. Full module consolidation/rename deferred.
column15: Partial: constant drift fixed now; consolidating the two modules is safer once `tsc` runs locally again.
